tasks.analysis: Paleontology is the scientific study that deals with the history of life through the analysis of fossil records. This field involves examining fossils—remains of organisms preserved in rock—to understand how ancient life-forms evolved and adapted to their surroundings. Paleontologists also use fossils to learn about ancient environmental conditions. Finding marine fossils in landlocked areas, for example, suggests that these regions were very likely underwater once upon a time. 古生物学是一门通过分析化石记录来研究地球生命发展史的学科。该领域包含研究化石 —— 封存于岩石中的生物遗骸，以此探究远古生物如何演化、适应环境。古生物学家还借助化石还原远古环境。比如在内陆发现海洋化石，就说明这些地区曾经大概率被海水覆盖。
